test_title: PYST 47: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The statement below has been given with bracketed text, Select the option with correct Idiom for the bracketed text.

Mom said these instructions are (not understood by her) and that we should show them to Dad.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Greek to her**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct idiom to replace the bracketed text is mentioned in option 1.**
 
• The idiom 'Greek to someone' means that something is not understandable to them.' (कुछ उनकी समझ में नहीं आ रहा है)
 
 
• Example: He tried to explain the rules of the game to me, but it was all Greek to me.
 
 
 
• The use of 'her' in the sentence indicates that the speaker is referring to their mother.
 
• **The sentence implies that the mother is having difficulty understanding the instructions.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (smart cookie to her) means that someone is intelligent or clever, but it does not fit in the context of the sentence.

 
 
• ​कोई बुद्धिमान या चतुर है
 
 
 
• Option 3 (pound the investment to her) is not an idiom and does not make sense in the sentence.
 
• Option 4 (full of beans to her) means that someone is energetic or enthusiastic, but it does not fit in the context of the sentence.
 
 
• कोई ऊर्जावान या उत्साही है
